name: NusukChat 2.9.1: Badge
source: The DL Advisor's change to 💬 Chat UI on 25 November 2026: a new local Badge set (Color × Status) placed first in the _Chat Container Body.

added.what: 50 × 50. success: rosette + tick-02 24 at 13,13; failure: rounded triangle (48 × 42 at 1,4) + unavailable 20 at 15,22; alert: hexagon (43.3 × 49.4 at 3.65,0.3) + alert-02 38 at 6,6. light: Alerts/Surface/Success · Error · Warning with Alerts/Icons/*; dark: Alerts/Surface/Solid * with Alerts/Icons/White.

changed.change: badge prop: first in the bubble at the start edge.

openDL: Figma: rename the solid variants to Color=Dark (they duplicate Color=Light, Status=Faliure / Alert), and Faliure → Failure.
Figma: alert-02 is 38 inside a 43 hexagon; 24 would match the other badges.
Figma: add a Show Badge boolean on _Chat Container; today the layer is shown or hidden by hand.

native.ios: A 50 × 50 ZStack: the shape as a Path filled with the Alerts surface token, the DL icon on top at the Figma offset; accessibilityLabel from the status.
native.android: Box(Modifier.size(50.dp)) { Icon(shape vector, tint = Alerts surface); Icon(DL icon, tint = Alerts icon or White) }; contentDescription from the status.
